title.hr: Što se mijenja na svakom skoku

concept.hr: MAC adrese mijenjaju se po skoku, IP adrese ostaju, TTL pada, zbroj se računa
concept.en: MACs change per hop, IPs stay, TTL drops, the checksum is recomputed

summary.hr: Ping kroz jedan ili dva usmjernika: nov okvir na svakom segmentu, iste IP adrese, TTL − 1 i nov kontrolni zbroj; TTL 0 vraća ICMP Time Exceeded.
summary.en: A ping through one or two routers: a new frame on every segment, the same IP addresses, TTL − 1 and a new checksum; TTL 0 returns ICMP Time Exceeded.
